alternate-current:
Alternate Current is an efficient and non-locational redstone dust implementation. Its main focus lies in reducing the lag caused by redstone dust, by optimizing the power calculations and reducing the number of shape and block updates emitted. As a side effect of these changes the block update order of redstone dust networks is predictable and intuitive rather than locational and chaotic.

 Performance

MSPT contributions of redstone dust are up to 30 times lower with Alternate Current, all the while maintaining a high level of Vanilla parity. Its low number of code modifications make it minimally invasive, so it's an easy drop-in replacement for Vanilla redstone dust.

Check out the GitHub page for a detailed explanation of Alternate Current's improvements.

Smooth Boot (Reloaded) is a optimization mod and unofficial fork of Smooth Boot for Minecraft Forge 1.18.2+, If you have a PC with a older or lower end CPU (ex. CPUs with 8 or less threads), you may have noticed that Minecraft takes up 100% of the CPU when loading into the title screen, causing cursor stutter and makes multitasking painfully difficult. Smooth Boot (Reloaded) solves this problem completely, and loading should be much smoother and potentially faster as well.

Change amount of threads used for loading
Change priority of threads used by Minecraft

 How the mod works

GuideME

This project offers the foundation for your mods or modpacks guidebook. Based on the technology powering Applied Energistics 2s guidebook, it allows you to write your guide in simple Markdown, while embedding 3d scenes straight from structure files.

For players, guides based on GuideME offer:

- Smooth scrolling goodness
- Content being front and center, with an advanced text layout engine supporting reflow and inline elements
- Interactive 3D scenes with annotations, intuitively illustrating concepts from your mod
- Cross-linking between topics and quick information in link tooltips

FOR OLDER VERSIONS, USE THE ORIGNIAL Better Biome Blend

 About

Better Biome Blend is a Client-Side performance and bug-fix mod. It adds support for smooth, large scale, sRGB correct biome color transitions. With the mod installed you can set the "Biome Blend" setting in your video options from 0x0 to 29x29. Compared to Vanilla, this setting no longer impacts performance.

 About 1.18+

Better Biome Blend will always use a 29x29 biome blending radius (Unless on Sodium, which is forced 14x14.) This is because biomes are now 3D instead of 2D, which makes biome color calculation a lot harder. This required writing a more specialized algorithm, but in return the mod is still as fast as it is in 1.17. Better Biome Blend also completely supports grass, water and leaves in caves, while vanilla currently does not.

Usually, to optimize performance, all blocks that are behind/outside your screen are not rendered to avoid useless computations.
In blocks, this bound is set to a 3x3 area, but in block entities, this is customizable.

THE BOILED ONE 

This horror mod adds a "The Boiled One" into Minecraft. He is an entity with a custom AI system and is highly configurable. This entity was created by the YouTuber Doctor Nowhere.

 

 What does he do? 
- Stalk the player if he's not attacking by slowly moving closer to the player. If the player leaves his sight of 120 blocks he will teleport closer.
- After a while of stalking, he will either choose to attack the player, scare the player (runs up then despawns) or just despawn.
- Configurable chance to watch you sleep, he will move closer to the bed until he is on top of it and wakes the player giving them paralysis, unless they leave the bed in which he will despawn.
- Spawn blood rain around the player in which they receive paralysis.

 What is configurable? 
- Time delay between spawns [default 6000 in-game ticks]

Server Side Vein Mine
This is a fabric server mod to add vein mining. Fabric API is the only dependency. 

You can add blocks to the list with the command /config serverveinmine veinMineableBlocks add [block]

Or you can edit the config json in [server-dir]/config/serverveinmine/config.json 

A 3x3x3 area centred on the target block will be checked for blocks or their deepslate equivalents. If another block of the same type is found, it is queued and a 3x3x3 is checked on it.

The default maximum is 64 blocks, above that to prevent lag the vein mine will be rejected.

Toggle Toggle Sneak

A client-side Minecraft mod for Fabric that allows you to toggle vanilla's toggle sneak option (the one in Options Controls) with a keybind instead of having to open the settings

 Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader . 
2. Place the mod .jar in your mods folder, alongside Fabric API . 
3. Launch Minecraft with Fabric.

 Usage

- While in a world/server, you can press a keybind (default: \ ) and the mod will update the toggle sneak setting's value and will tell you whether it turned it on or off. 
- The keybind can be changed in Minecraft's settings.

 Notes

- Client-side only — safe to join any server (vanilla, modded, Paper, etc.). 
- Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

By grinding up chicken for the filling, and bread for the nugget breading, you can combine the byproducts to make chicken nuggets of various shapes. no-chat-delay:
No Chat Delay

A client-side mod that removes the internal processing delay for incoming Minecraft chat messages.

 What does this do?
In vanilla Minecraft, incoming chat messages are placed into a queue and tied to the game's tick rate. This creates an artificial delay (~50ms, but much worse if the server or client is lagging) between the network receiving a message and it actually appearing on your screen.

 No Chat Delay bypasses this waiting period. It forces the game to process the message, verify signatures, and render the text on the exact same frame the packet arrives.

 Features:
 Faster chat: about 50ms or more depending on context.
 Lag Resistant: Chat renders instantly even if the server TPS drops.
 High Compatibility: Safely forces the vanilla processing queue rather than skipping it. It should not break chat filters, secure chat signatures, or chat loggers.
 100% Client-Sid

Network Blocker is a utility mod that allows you to block unwanted network connection.

By default, this mod permits connections made by vanilla Minecraft, which are necessary for authentication, etc. Network connections made by mods are blocked by default.

no-farmland-trampling:
Description
This mod disables farmland trampling, allowing your crops to be safe from both you and any mobs or animals that wander on your fields. This mod is ideal for those who have large crop fields but don't want to deal with the random dirt patches left from entities wandering around.

 Togglability

There are two ways to toggle this mod. Through the compatible mod "Mod Menu" or through the built-in custom command. The command to change the crop's level of protection is:
 /tramplingProtection [level]

It is initially set to FULL, preventing trampling from everything. There are four levels of protection for your farmland to choose from:
- Protected from everything (FULL)
- Protected from mobs but not the player (ONLY MOBS)
- Protected from players but not mobs (ONLY PLAYERS)
- Protected from nothing (NONE)

Have you ever felt that potion effects get in the way of your adventure? Large swirls and bubbles can clutter your screen, especially during intense combat or building sessions. CleanView solves this issue elegantly and simply.

Unlike other mods that disable particles entirely, CleanView works intelligently:

First-Person Clarity: Your view remains perfectly clear while playing in first-person mode. No more distracting spirals in your face.

Visual Feedback: Switch to third-person view (F5), and all particles will still be visible on your character. You can still see your effects and look cool.

Cobblemobs is a mod that replaces vanilla Minecraft mobs with Pokemon. 

---

stackcluster-optimizer:
A lightweight client-side FPS optimization mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric).
When large amounts of the same item are dropped on the ground in a pile — like after a mob farm, bulk crafting, or a death — Minecraft renders every single item entity individually, which can tank your FPS. StackCluster fixes this by detecting clusters of the same item and hiding a configurable percentage of them visually. The items still exist and can be picked up normally — they're just not rendered.
Features:

Fully client-side — works on any server, no server-side install needed
Configurable cluster radius (how far to search for same-type items)
Configurable minimum cluster size (how many items trigger culling)
Configurable cull percentage (how many items in a cluster to hide)
Master on/off toggle
In-game config screen via ModMenu + Cloth Config

Requirements:

Fabric Loader 0.19+

Fabric API

Cloth Config

 What it does

 /cgen create heal utils:heal player — that's it. 
Players can now type /heal and your datapack function runs. Instantly. For everyone.

Commands persist across restarts, show up in tab completion, and can be removed just as easily.

 Commands

 /cgen create 
Registers a new slash command that runs a datapack function.
 
/cgen create heal utils:heal player
/cgen create "shop haste" mypack:give haste
 

 Players can now type /heal or /shop haste — no client mod needed.

---

 /cgen remove 
Unregisters a command immediately. Gone from tab completion too.
 
/cgen remove heal

In older versions of Pocket Edition, renaming items prevented them from despawning. However, Mojang saw this as more of a bug than a feature and ended up patching it.

This datapack makes it so items cannot despawn when renamed in an anvil. Long story short, now!

How does this work? This datapack runs a function every 5 minutes to check for any item with their minecraft:custom name component changed, and when it does, it resets its despawn timer.

This mod was really created for the Cobblemon Delta server to prevent players from griefing with their Pokémon during events. This mod does not change or delete Pokémon in any way. It simply skips rendering their models so that players can play without the visual spam.
death-penalty:
This mod aims to make your life more valuable by temporarily banning you from the server. Each player has their own penalty index, which increases each time they cause the death of a player (even their own). If you die, your penalty will be imposed, which is defined by the Fibonacci sequence and can range from 0 minutes to 17711 minutes (12 days, 7 hours and 11 minutes) depending on your penalty index.

 Penalty Rules
- Player A dies on his own
 - Player A gets his current penalty applied
 - Player A gets his penalty index increased
- Player A kills player B
 - Player B gets his current penalty applied
 - Player A gets his penalty index increased

 Penalty Time
The penalty time is defined by the Fibonacci sequence from 0 to 22.

- Immediate crashes when launching with Celestial 2.0 on NeoForge
- Mixin application failures referencing missing field mappings
- Inability to use Celestial's sky customization features on Forge-based modpacks

- Sky and fog color customization
- Custom skyboxes and animated skies

Work Penalty is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that shows an item's repair cost directly in its tooltip, so you always know how expensive your next anvil operation will be before you commit to it.

 What it does

- Red: repair cost is 15 or higher, you're approaching the "Too Expensive!" limit

anticheat-mod-whitelist:
Mod List

 A Fabric server-side mod that enforces a strict modpack whitelist or blacklist — players running unauthorized mods are automatically kicked. 

---

 What it does

Minecraft doesn't natively expose a client's installed mod list to the server. Mod Whitelist fixes that gap: every time a player joins, their client (which must also have this mod installed) sends the server a list of every mod it has loaded. The server checks that list against an admin-defined whitelist and disconnects the player if anything doesn't match.

This is useful for server owners who want to guarantee every connected player is running the exact approved modpack — no extra performance mods that break balance, no client-side exploits.

---

 Installation

 Server
1. Place mod-whitelist-1.0.0.jar in your server's mods/ folder.
2. Start the server once. This auto-generates the config file at config/mod-whiteli

Tired of emptying containers just to move them?
MineCarry lets you pick up and relocate most vanilla containers with everything still inside. Move your storage quickly, safely, and without the mess.

How it works

 Pick up:
Sneak (Shift) + Right Click a supported container with an empty main hand.

 Carry:
The container is stored as a special marker item in your selected hotbar slot. While carrying it, you will have a movement speed penalty.

 Place:
Sneak (Shift) + Right Click on a block face to place it back down, fully restoring its BlockState and BlockEntity NBT (including inventory).

 Supported blocks

Chests (including double chests)
Barrels
Furnaces and other vanilla container blocks

Not supported

- y: The number changes with small changes.

The Slots SMP Remake is a unique twist on the classic Minecraft Survival Multiplayer experience. In this SMP, your inventory management is more crucial than ever. Overview
 
The British Rail Class 221 Super Voyager is a class of tilting diesel-electric multiple unit express passenger trains built in Bruges, Belgium and Wakefield, by Bombardier Transportation in 2001–02.

The class is similar to the Class 220 Voyager, but was built with a tilting mechanism enabling up to six degrees of tilt to allow higher speeds on curved tracks. Additionally, most have five coaches, and they have a different bogie design. They have a maximum speed of 125 mph (200 km/h).

This resource pack is to add the Virgin Trains BR Class 221 into Minecraft with Minecraft Transit Railway mod, made by PlaneSimple for Transport Fever 2 and Converted to Minecraft by Vitor2005 in 2025.

 Disclaimer
This resource pack is not associated with, and is not an official product of, Virgin Rail Group.

概述 英国铁路221型超级旅行者号（英语：British Rail Class 221 Super Voyager）是一种由庞巴迪运输公司于2001年至2002年在比利时布鲁日和韦克菲尔德建造的摆式柴油-电力动车组快速客运列车。 该级别与220航海家级类似，但配备了倾斜机构，可倾斜6度，以在曲线轨道上实现更高的速度。此外，大多数都有5节车厢，并有不同的转向架设计。它们的最高速度为125英里/小时（200公里/小时）。 此资源包将维珍列车BR 221级加入到《我的世界》中，并在2025年由Vitor2005转换为《我的世界》运输狂热2。 免责声明 本资源包与维珍铁路集团无关，也不是维珍铁路集团的官方产品。

This pack was born from this desire I had while playing on an SMP, when I especially wanted an option that didn't require modded items to use. Previous packs achieved custom models with Optifine or CIT (which is defunct), this pack will work in all new vanilla versions.

 Use the README in the pack to get the names required to activate the desired item!

- String lights (Fairy lights) add a touch of detail to your base, while still fitting into vanilla survival gameplay.

mtr4-jr-east-e131-series-jre131:
The E131 series is a narrow-gauge DC electric multiple unit (EMU) train operated by the East Japan Railway Company (JR East). Designed for smaller lines, they consist of two to four cars per train set and are equipped for driver-only operation (Wanman, ワンマン - "one-man"). They entered service in 2021 in the Chiba area, and subsequent variants for other regions were since introduced.

This resource pack adds the E131 series to the Minecraft Transit Railway mod with a custom model and textures.

The variants included in this pack and their recommended formations are as follows:

- E131-0: 2 cars
- E131-500: 4 cars
- E131-600: 3 cars
- E131-800: 4 cars

E131系列是东日本铁路公司（JR East）运营的窄轨直流电动动车组（EMU）列车，每列2 ~ 4汽车，专为小型线路设计，并配备了驾驶员专用型（Wanman）。2021年在千叶地区投入运营，之后又推出了其他地区的动车组。 这个资源包将E131系列添加到Minecraft Transit Railway 模组中，并提供了自定义模型和材质。 本包装中包含的变体及其建议的结构如下： - E131-0：2辆汽车 - E131-500：4辆汽车 - E131-600：3辆汽车 - E131-800：4辆汽车

distinctive-ores:
This pack gives ores unique and fun designs while remaining true to the vanilla style. The goal is to improve playability and accessibility by making each ore identifiable by shape. 1.17's texture update aimed to do something similar, but the shapes of the ores are largely random and hard to tell apart when colour is absent. This pack aims to rectify that.

Each ore is given a stylised and thoughtful shape: gold forms shiny bars, lapis forms flowing waves, redstone forms circuit-like crystals. These all serve to give each ore its own identity and make them stand out.

这款套装在保持原版风格的同时，赋予了矿石独特有趣的设计。目标是通过使每一种矿石的形状可识别来提高可玩性和可访问性。1.17的材质更新旨在做一些类似的事情，但矿石的形状大多是随机的，当没有颜色时很难区分。这款套装旨在纠正这一点。 每一种矿石都被赋予了一种风格化和深思熟虑的形状：黄金形成了闪亮的条状，青金石形成了流动的波浪，红石形成了回路状的晶体。所有这些都赋予了每一种矿石自己的身份，使它们脱颖而出。

bad-pc-optimizations:
Bad PC Optimizations

A resource pack that removes visual effects to lighten the load on weaker PCs.

 What it does: 
- Disables all animated textures (water, lava, fire, portals, smoke) so they render static
- Makes every particle invisible, so nothing is drawn on screen
- Removes the shader folder from the pack

 
 Warning 

This pack disables particles and animations, so visual feedback like fire, rain and explosions disappears. Particles are still processed by the game, they are just not drawn. For real FPS gains on weak PCs use performance mods like Sodium or Lithium and lower your graphics settings.

 

 Performance test (DonutSMP, donutsmp.net): 
- Without pack: 195–305 FPS
- With pack: 231–385 FPS
- Results may vary depending on your system

 Who likes nasty grass?
NoFoliage solves the well-known problem of nasty grass and boosts your FPS by unrendering it.

 How does this boost FPS?
Minecraft renders every block you see. If there are more blocks or entities, Minecraft has to load more textures, which means that your FPS drops. Because grass is almost everywhere on your world, Minecraft renders a lot of this. Also, we don't actually need grass, do we. This Pack removes the grass textures, which means that Minecraft does not have to render these anymore, or they don't impact performance negatively.

EnchantFlex is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that allows you to control the maximum levels of enchantments on your server.

It lets server owners easily customize enchantment limits through a simple configuration file without modifying the game itself.

The plugin is optimized and works smoothly on Paper, Spigot, and Purpur servers.

 
 Features
 
 ⚙ Configure maximum enchantment levels
 
 📄 Simple and easy-to-edit configuration file
 
 🧩 Supports all vanilla enchantments
 
 🔧 Automatically supports both modern and legacy enchantment names
 
 🚀 Lightweight and optimized

Example

You can set custom enchantment limits such as:

 
Sharpness 8
Protection 10
Efficiency 10
Unbreaking 5

 

 Configuration 

 
config.yml
 

 Global maximum level 

 
default-max-level: 100
 

If an enchantment is not listed, this value will be used as its maximum level.
